name: Private Keys Reconnaissance Via CommandLine Tools
description: Adversaries may search for private key certificate files on compromised systems for insecurely stored credential
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.command_line:(*.key* OR *.pgp* OR *.gpg* OR *.ppk* OR *.p12* OR *.pem* OR *.pfx* OR *.cer* OR *.p7b* OR *.asc*)) AND (((process.executable:*\\cmd.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:Cmd.Exe) AND process.command_line:*dir\ *) OR (((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND process.command_line:*Get\-ChildItem\ *) OR (process.executable:*\\findstr.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:FINDSTR.EXE))
